BA is one of the two permitted names under your mandate, and since the notes frame you as a long-term holder, I checked the fundamentals from Boeing's FY2023 10-K before acting: revenue of $77,794M, operating cash flow of $5,960M (positive, which supports the long-term thesis), but net income of –$2,222M and diluted EPS of –$3.67/share (still loss-making).
